far.rm: Show the selected base maximum and unit-band context; project FAR separately needs Code-compatible GFA and legal premises area.
far.rs: Show the applicable Table 131-04J lot-area branch and separately disclose the steep-hillside formula when unresolved.

height.blocked_copy: Project-height compliance needs a Code-compatible grade and top-elevation analysis.
height.rm: Show the selected base maximum and angled-envelope/overlay qualifiers; project comparison separately needs Code-compatible height evidence.
height.rs: Show 24 ft at applicable setback lines and 30 ft overall with the lot-width-selected angled plane; never flatten 24/30.

legal_lot_area.assessor_area: Recorded administrative fact; not automatically Code area.
legal_lot_area.code_regulatory_area: Code-defined area used for the named regulation.
legal_lot_area.unresolved_effect: Block every rule whose denominator or boundary depends on legal-lot identity.

lot_coverage.not_specified_copy: No numeric base-zone lot-coverage standard identified.
lot_coverage.rs_conditional_copy: A 50% maximum applies when more than half the premises contains steep hillsides; that condition must be evaluated.

setbacks.existing_or_project_compliance: Requires compatible geometry for the named existing structure or proposal.
setbacks.requirement_conditional: Show the base value and named unresolved branches.
